fields.cell: [width, height] of one frame in px; frames run left to right in one row
fields.fps: suggested playback speed; 0 = not an animation (pick a frame)
fields.pivot: Unity pivot [x from left, y from BOTTOM], 0..1
fields.anchor_px: the same point in px from the TOP-LEFT of the cell (for canvas drawImage)
fields.blend: alpha = normal blending; additive = add (canvas "lighter"), also acceptable as alpha
fields.scale: suggested scale for a tier-1 creature (128 px = 1 build cell); see notes for other sizes
fields.layer: ground = under units, over = on top of the unit, icon = above the head/health bar, screen = full-viewport overlay
fields.tintable: true = neutral white wax, multiply with the creature accent colour
fields.status_icon_frames: frame index of each status badge inside vfx_status_icons

effects.name: vfx_step_dust
effects.when: walk: spawn at a foot on every step (walk frames 0 and half-cycle). Map: Outskirts road, Old Town cobbles (default)
effects.notes: grey-brown dust puff; scale 0.6 for shard/cub, 1.8 for bosses

effects.name: vfx_step_splash
effects.when: walk: spawn at a foot on every step (walk frames 0 and half-cycle). Map: Harbor (wet planks, water edge)
effects.notes: water ripple and droplets; scale 0.6 for shard/cub, 1.8 for bosses

effects.name: vfx_step_salt
effects.when: walk: spawn at a foot on every step (walk frames 0 and half-cycle). Map: White Plains
effects.notes: white salt puff with square crystals; scale 0.6 for shard/cub, 1.8 for bosses

effects.name: vfx_step_snow
effects.when: walk: spawn at a foot on every step (walk frames 0 and half-cycle). Map: Observatory
effects.notes: lavender snow puff with flakes; scale 0.6 for shard/cub, 1.8 for bosses

effects.name: vfx_wax_drip
effects.when: walk: wax drop falling off the creature every 0.4-0.8 s, leaves a small splat
effects.notes: neutral white wax; tint (multiply) with the creature accent colour

effects.name: vfx_hit_splash
effects.when: hit: at the impact point when a creature takes damage (with vfx_hit_flash)
effects.notes: wax shards and droplets; tint with the creature accent colour

effects.name: vfx_hit_flash
effects.when: hit: one short white impact flash at the impact point
effects.notes: draw above the splash

effects.name: vfx_attack_slash
effects.when: attack: claw swipe in front of tiger, tiger cub, alpha tiger, frenzy, crab (attack frame 2-3)
effects.notes: drawn swiping toward +x (east); rotate to the attack direction, flipX for west

effects.name: vfx_attack_swipe
effects.when: attack: weapon swing arc for armed creatures (standard, primordial, healer, spore, mother tree, lens, mirror, prism, ultimate, myriad)
effects.notes: drawn swinging toward +x; rotate to the attack direction; scale 1.8 for bosses

effects.name: vfx_attack_impact
effects.when: attack: burst at the target (wall or squad) on the hit frame of any creature attack
effects.notes: scale 0.6 for shard/cub, 1.6 for bosses

effects.name: vfx_death_melt
effects.when: death: wax puddle that spreads then evaporates (0.4 s) under any creature, starts with the die animation
effects.notes: neutral white wax; tint with the accent colour; scale 0.5 shard/cub, 2.0 bosses

effects.name: vfx_drop_resource
effects.when: death: gold 4-point star rising where a creature dropped resources
effects.notes: shape = star (resource)

effects.name: vfx_drop_specimen
effects.when: death: lilac hexagon gem rising where a creature dropped a research specimen
effects.notes: shape = hexagon gem (specimen), so it does not rely on colour

effects.name: vfx_shadow_blob
effects.when: always: soft blob shadow under a unit that has no baked shadow (flying shards, pouncing boss, pods)
effects.notes: scale x to the unit width; shrink while the unit is in the air

effects.name: vfx_status_burning
effects.when: status burning (Flamethrower): loop on the creature while it burns
effects.notes: flames hug the feet and the sides so the body stays visible; scale = unit cell / 128 (0.5 shard, 2.0 boss). Replaces the 32 px placeholder Towers/Flamethrower/vfx_burning.png

effects.name: vfx_status_frozen
effects.when: status frozen (Cryo Tower fully freezes the lens tier and interrupts focus): loop while frozen
effects.notes: ice crust at the feet plus a see-through frost sheen; also tint the unit pale blue in code

effects.name: vfx_status_frozen_break
effects.when: status frozen ends: ice crust shatters
effects.notes: one shot, then remove vfx_status_frozen

effects.name: vfx_status_solvent
effects.when: status solvent (Solvent Sprayer puddle, Hunter weapons): loop while the creature is dissolving (cannot heal, armour melts)
effects.notes: acid drips running down the body and bubbles at the feet

effects.name: vfx_status_netted
effects.when: status netted (Net Launcher): loop while the creature is tied down (bosses and the ultimate tier are only slowed: use vfx_status_slowed for them)
effects.notes: see-through rope dome with weights; matches Towers/NetLauncher/vfx_net_trap

effects.name: vfx_status_slowed
effects.when: status slowed (Cryo Tower aura; Net Launcher on bosses and the ultimate tier): loop at the feet
effects.notes: frost ring with dragging chevrons and snowflakes; drawn under the unit

effects.name: vfx_status_tar
effects.when: status tar-stuck (Warden tar trap): loop at the feet while the creature is stuck
effects.notes: dark tar puddle with stretching strands; drawn under the unit, strands overlap the feet

effects.name: vfx_status_icons
effects.when: status: badge above the head of a creature for each active status (GDD 8.5: never colour alone). Frame index = 0 burning, 1 frozen, 2 solvent, 3 netted, 4 slowed, 5 tar, 6 haste, 7 regen
effects.notes: not an animation: pick one frame per status. Each badge has its own plate SHAPE: burning circle, frozen hexagon, solvent droplet, netted square, slowed diamond, tar light shield, haste up-arrow, regen cross. Place side by side 4 px above the health bar; keep at scale 1 (40 px) for all units

effects.name: vfx_heal_ring
effects.when: healer (tier 3) heal: green zone on the ground while it stands still and heals; radius = heal radius
effects.notes: ellipse 236x172 px in the cell; scale so the ring matches the heal radius (y squash 0.72)

effects.name: vfx_heal_sparkle
effects.when: heal received: loop on every creature that is being healed by a healer or by the mother tree roots
effects.notes: green plus signs rising; pair with the regen badge (vfx_status_icons frame 7)

effects.name: vfx_lens_charge_bar
effects.when: lens (tier 4) focus: bar above the head filling over 5 s while it stands next to a tower; frame = round(progress * 20); frame 20 = full (tower destroyed)
effects.notes: 5 segments = 5 seconds; high visual priority (GDD 8.3). Reset to frame 0 when the Cryo Tower freezes the creature

effects.name: vfx_lens_beam
effects.when: lens (tier 4) focus: light beam from the lens on its back to the tower it is destroying
effects.notes: tileable along x and seamless as a loop: anchor at the lens, rotate toward the tower and stretch or repeat x to the distance. Amber edge so it reads on the white salt flat

effects.name: vfx_lens_beam_hit
effects.when: lens focus / prism focus: hot spot on the tower at the end of the beam
effects.notes: spinning sun rays; scale up with charge (0.7 -> 1.2)

effects.name: vfx_frenzy_howl
effects.when: frenzy howl: sound-wave rings expanding from the creature when it speeds up nearby creatures (howl frame 2); scale to the buff radius
effects.notes: crimson broken rings; buffed allies get the haste badge (vfx_status_icons frame 6)

effects.name: vfx_ultimate_regen
effects.when: ultimate (tier 5) self-heal tick: pulse rising around the body every time it regenerates
effects.notes: one shot per tick; do not play while burning or under solvent (healing is blocked)

effects.name: vfx_spore_burst
effects.when: spore death: purple spore cloud and 3 wax chunks flying out where the 3 shards will spawn (skip it when the spore dies burning or under solvent: it does not split)
effects.notes: chunks fly to 150, 30 and 270 degrees; spawn the shards at those offsets (about 40 px)

effects.name: vfx_crab_shell_soften
effects.when: crab under solvent: shell flakes sliding off while its front armour is melted (optional overlay on top of vfx_status_solvent)
effects.notes: coral flakes; for the mother tree bark tint the flakes brown

effects.name: vfx_mirror_reflect
effects.when: mirror reflect: spark on the salt-crystal skin when it bounces a single-target shot back (Machine Gun, Sniper, Hunter); also the prism boss mirror skin
effects.notes: the streak leaves toward +x: rotate toward the tower that fired

effects.name: vfx_primordial_crack_glow
effects.when: boss 1 Shed warning (66% and 33% HP): cracks on the body glow pale white-yellow for 3 s before the wax plates fall off
effects.notes: centre on the chest (about 110 px above the feet); pulse gets faster in code (fps 10 -> 20). Additive, but also fine with normal alpha

effects.name: vfx_primordial_shed_burst
effects.when: boss 1 Shed: wax plates blast off the body and become 8-10 shards around the boss
effects.notes: spawn the shards as the plates land (frame 5)

effects.name: vfx_tiger_pounce_line
effects.when: boss 2 Pounce warning (2 s crouch): red chevron line on the lane from the boss to the landing point
effects.notes: tileable along x and seamless as a loop: rotate toward the landing point and repeat x to the distance. Follows the lane; end it with vfx_tiger_pounce_marker

effects.name: vfx_tiger_pounce_marker
effects.when: boss 2 Pounce warning: landing marker on the lane for the 2 s crouch (blink faster near the end)
effects.notes: supersedes the 128x64 placeholder Wax/AlphaTiger/vfx_pounce_target.png; red target with a paw print

effects.name: vfx_tiger_land_dust
effects.when: boss 2 Pounce landing: dust ring and cracks where the boss lands
effects.notes: also usable for the primordial heavy step at scale 0.6

effects.name: vfx_tiger_roar_ring
effects.when: boss 2 Call the Pack (50% HP): roar rings from the boss when it summons tiger cubs (roar frame 3), together with vfx_screen_edge_pulse
effects.notes: jagged gold and bone rings; scale 1.5 on the boss

effects.name: vfx_screen_edge_pulse
effects.when: boss 2 Call the Pack warning: screen edges blink red while the boss roars; also usable for the myriad Last Heart darkening with a dark tint
effects.notes: single frame: stretch over the whole viewport and animate alpha in code (0 -> 0.9 -> 0, 3 pulses of 0.5 s). Centre is fully transparent so it never hides enemies or the storm ring

effects.name: vfx_tiger_headbutt_impact
effects.when: boss 2 Wall Ram (first hit on the wall, after a 1.5 s head-down warning): impact burst on the wall (headbutt frame 3)
effects.notes: also good for the primordial heavy wall hit

effects.name: vfx_tree_root_ring
effects.when: boss 3 Feeding Roots (always on): green ring on the ground around the walking boss; creatures inside heal slowly
effects.notes: ellipse 352x256 px; scale so it matches the aura radius. Loop

effects.name: vfx_tree_seed_pod_blink
effects.when: boss 3 Seeding (66% and 33% HP): seed pod dropped on the lane, blinking for 5 s before it hatches into a healer
effects.notes: raise fps from 6 to 16 over the 5 s; pods can be destroyed by area damage

effects.name: vfx_tree_seed_pod_hatch
effects.when: boss 3 Seeding: the pod swells, cracks and bursts; spawn the healer on frame 4
effects.notes: play instead of the blink loop when the 5 s are over

effects.name: vfx_prism_charge_beam
effects.when: boss 4 Focus and Multi-Focus: rainbow beam from the prism sceptre to each targeted tower, charging for 5 s
effects.notes: tileable along x and seamless as a loop: rotate and repeat x to the distance; scale y 0.4 -> 1.0 with charge progress

effects.name: vfx_prism_target_marker
effects.when: boss 4 Multi-Focus (50% HP): marker under each of the 3 targeted towers for the 5 s charge
effects.notes: high priority (same family as the storm ring): draw it above tower bases, never above the storm ring

effects.name: vfx_prism_mirror_glint
effects.when: boss 4 Mirror Skin (always on): glints running over the crystals every few seconds, and whenever a single-target shot is reflected
effects.notes: centre on the body; additive, also fine with normal alpha

effects.name: vfx_prism_core_glow
effects.when: boss 4 Open Core (while it charges a beam, it takes double damage): glowing core on the chest crystal
effects.notes: centre on the big chest crystal; additive, also fine with normal alpha

effects.name: vfx_myriad_absorb_trail
effects.when: boss 5 Absorb (always on): wax of a creature that died nearby streams toward the boss and heals it
effects.notes: tileable along x and seamless as a loop; blobs travel toward +x: anchor at the corpse, rotate toward the boss, repeat x to the distance. Blocked by fire and solvent

effects.name: vfx_myriad_scream_wave
effects.when: boss 5 Ten Thousand (66% and 33% HP): the faces scream and a wave spreads out as it spawns a mixed pack with a frenzy
effects.notes: jagged violet rings; play on the scream frame

effects.name: vfx_myriad_heart_glow
effects.when: boss 5 Last Heart (10% HP): the eclipsed-sun heart opens on its back and beats; only squads can damage it
effects.notes: centre on the heart on the boss back; heartbeat loop (two thumps per cycle)
